inbox.subject: Fight week: Presentation Night
inbox.body: Presentation Night is this Saturday at Ironworks Social Club. 450 tickets sold. Open the event to run the night.

inbox.subject: MEDIA REQUEST: Boxing Daily would like Josh Ashworth
inbox.body: Boxing Daily has asked for an interview with Josh Ashworth. You can accept, decline, or offer another fighter from your roster. The request lapses in 3 weeks.

inbox.subject: Fight offer: Josh Ashworth v Fraser Rennie
inbox.body: Northern Lights Boxing want a step-up test for Fraser Rennie (8-5-0) and see Josh Ashworth (2-1-0) as the right opponent. They are offering a place on Northern Lights Boxing 2: Leeds, Leeds. The offer stands for 2 weeks.

inbox.subject: SOLD OUT: Presentation Night
inbox.body: Every seat for Presentation Night has gone. Next time, consider a bigger venue or higher prices.

inbox.subject: Presentation Night put on sale automatically
inbox.body: Tickets were opened late with your current prices so the show is not left empty.

inbox.subject: Tickets on sale: Presentation Night
inbox.body: Presentation Night is on sale. Watch sales each week and adjust prices or marketing if it is slow.

inbox.subject: Word on the circuit: Calum Lennox
inbox.body: People in the gyms are talking about Calum Lennox (Glasgow, 11-12-1). You may want to take a look.

inbox.subject: Fight agreed: Connor Pritchard vs Marcus Thorne
inbox.body: Marcus Thorne's camp has agreed terms: £7,000 purse. Choose a date to schedule the fight.

inbox.subject: Counter-offer from Marcus Thorne's camp
inbox.body: They want changes: a few adjustments.

inbox.subject: Fight agreed: Jordan Dobson vs Emiliano Estrada

inbox.subject: Counter-offer from Emiliano Estrada's camp
inbox.body: They want changes: their promotion is wary of an unproven rival promoter.

inbox.subject: Counter-offer from Jonas Hartmann's camp

inbox.subject: Jonas Hartmann turns down the fight
inbox.body: Jonas Hartmann's camp said no: wants a bigger purse.

inbox.subject: Meet your first fighters
inbox.body: Your gym is home to Ellis Ashworth, Jordan Dobson, Connor Pritchard, Josh Ashworth. Set each fighter's training focus from their profile — it changes how they develop every week.

inbox.subject: Welcome to P48
inbox.body: T, the paperwork is signed and the doors are open. You have 4 fighters, a gym and £500k in the bank. Every week the bills land and the rest of boxing moves on without you. Scout the market, book a show, and watch the forecast before you commit.
